title: Longest Word
problem: Read one line of words separated by single spaces. Print the longest word. If several words are tied for the longest length, print the first of them. For example, I love programming gives programming.
starter_code:
# Read one line of words separated by spaces.
# Print the longest word (the first one if there is a tie).

# Write your code here

hints.1: Keep track of the best word you have seen so far and compare every new word with it.
hints.2: Split the line into words and loop over them, remembering the longest so far. Replace it only when a word is strictly longer, so that on a tie the earlier word stays.

failure_explanation: When two words are of equal length, the one that came first must win, so a new word has to be strictly longer than the best so far to replace it. Start with the first word as the best, so a line with a single word also works, and print the word itself, not its length.
